cells.function: Carry the session: Zoom hosts the room, Pencil carries the shared math surface.

value_props.value: one surface for voice, video and math
no bespoke infra to run

cells.function: Reconcile the live roster so every student maps to a known name before pairing.

value_props.value: greets a name, not a username
attendance data stays clean downstream

cells.function: Keep the classroom side steady while students transition into breakout rooms.

value_props.value: orderly transition, no dead air
school partner sees a managed room

cells.function: Gain visibility into the student's work: screen share is the tutor's only window into progress.
cells.form: A request, not a demand; explain why sharing helps.

value_props.value: sees the actual work, not a description of it
help lands on the real problem

cells.function: Open the tutoring moment: join the assigned breakout room within the first minute so the student is never waiting alone.
cells.form: Prompt and unhurried; camera on where policy allows.

value_props.value: never left waiting alone in a room
session clock starts on time; utilization holds

cells.function: Establish rapport before any task talk: a personal greeting by name sets the session's tone.
cells.form: Warm, by name, one personal beat before math.

value_props.value: feels seen before being assessed
rapport drives retention and engagement scores

cells.function: Close the loop cleanly and free the tutor for the next student in the sorted order.
cells.form: Brief goodbye that names what went well.

value_props.value: clean ending, named progress
tutor cycles to the next student without drift

cells.function: Log the help interaction so coverage gaps and repeat needs are visible across sessions.
cells.form: One tap; keeps focus on the student.

value_props.value: help coverage measurable per session
credit for the work actually done

cells.function: Record attendance in the PLUS app so staffing and payroll reconcile against real presence.
cells.form: Invisible to the student; never interrupts the conversation.

value_props.value: attendance ground truth for schools and payroll
live roster accuracy

cells.step: Remind Student They Can Ask for Help
cells.function: Set the help norm: student must know asking for help is expected and cheap, on content and on tech.
cells.form: Reassuring and matter-of-fact, not a disclaimer.

value_props.value: permission to ask lowers the cost of being stuck
fewer silent failures mid-session

cells.function: Capture an engagement baseline used by researchers and leads to spot struggling pairs early.
cells.form: Quick judgment call, logged without ceremony.

value_props.value: engagement signal feeds research and staffing
struggling pairs get help sooner
